tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Japanese articles published on issoh.co.jp (株式会社一創). Covers system development, AI/LLM, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), security, and web. "column" = business/decision-maker oriented, "tech" = implementation oriented. Returns titles, URLs and excerpts. Call get_article afterwards to read the full text.

query.description: 検索キーワード（日本語可）。例: "コンテナ オーケストレーション", "RAG 精度"

post_type.description: any=両方 / column=発注者向け / tech=実装者向け

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one issoh.co.jp article by URL or by id. Accepts URLs such as https://www.issoh.co.jp/column/details/16170/ or https://www.issoh.co.jp/tech/details/16216/. HTML is stripped and the body is truncated at 15000 characters.

url.description: 記事URL（id を使う場合は不要）

id.description: 記事ID（url を使う場合は不要）

post_type.description: id 指定のときの投稿タイプ。url 指定なら不要

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the services offered by 株式会社一創 (system development, AI, web, DX consulting, infrastructure), and the industry / business-problem guide pages (e.g. 製造業, 脱エクセル) that explain which services fit. Use this when the user is looking for a development vendor, a quote, or a partner for a specific technology, industry or problem. Omit the query to list every service and guide page.

query.description: 検索キーワード。省略すると全サービスを一覧する。例: "OCR", "SEO", "AWS"

limit.description: 返す件数（省略時は10。全件見るときは大きめの値を渡す）

tools.name: search_case_studies
tools.description: Search the published project portfolio (制作実績) and customer references (導入企業の声) of 株式会社一創. Use this to answer "do they have experience with X?" style questions.

query.description: 検索キーワード。省略すると新しい順に一覧する

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Return the company profile of 株式会社一創 and the canonical URLs for services, portfolio and the contact form. Use this when the user asks who they are or how to contact / request a quote.
